title: Untitled (Football and Planes)
description: Dense layered collage combining an american football, warplane silhouettes, concentric target rings, compact discs, and a grid-patterned ground across a wide horizontal format. Vertical red ribbon stripes bisect the composition, with scattered sequins, a floppy disk, and a football helmet visible among overlapping paper fragments.
composition: horizontal diptych with vertical red dividers
